title: Current and deferred taxes — Corbin Inc.
instructions: Compute Corbin Inc.'s 2025 income tax amounts. The enacted rate for 2025 and later years is 21%. No valuation allowance is needed, and there were no deferred tax balances at January 1, 2025. Round the effective rate to two decimals.

exhibits.title: Corbin Inc. — 2025 data
exhibits.content:
- Pretax financial income: **$900,000**.
- Tax depreciation exceeds book depreciation by **$60,000**.
- Warranty expense accrued for books but not yet paid: **$30,000** (deductible when paid).
- Interest on municipal bonds: **$20,000**.
- Fines paid for environmental violations: **$10,000**.

rows.label: Effective tax rate
rows.explanation: 186,900 ÷ 900,000 = **20.77%**; the permanent differences move it from 21%.
